svg.title: Gain with the other heater fixed, and with the other vessel held
svg.desc: With heater 2 fixed, a 5-point step of heater 1 raises vessel 1 by 0.690 degrees Celsius. With heater 2 corrected by minus 2.222 points in the same update, vessel 2 ends where it started and vessel 1 rises only 0.554 degrees; vessel 2 first dips to 34.906 degrees at 3.0 seconds. The ratio of the two gains is 1.245, and Control Studio's relative gain array gives 1.2426.
svg.text: Gain with the other heater fixed, and with the other vessel held
